summary: Tested 3 new UI features for chess coaching app: 1) Pattern Clustering in Training with filter tabs, 2) Enhanced 'Did you find it?' stats with miss_rate_at_your_level, 3) Habit Insight card on Home page. All backend APIs working. All frontend UI tests passed.
critical_code_review_comments: ThinkingTraining.jsx correctly implements pattern filter tabs with activeFilter state and filteredPositions useMemo
Pattern filter tabs show counts in parentheses (e.g., 'Positional (2)', 'Fork (1)')
Position counter updates correctly when filter changes (1/4 -> 1/2 for Positional)
Clicking 'All' filter resets to show all positions
HomePage.jsx correctly displays Habit Insight card with purple Brain icon when habits data exists
Habit card shows 'Watch: Complex Tactical Miss (0x recently)' in amber color
Pattern Prescription card shows 'PATTERNS TO FIX' with 3 patterns and their counts
Study card correctly says 'Your Openings' and navigates to /openings-overview
GET /api/home/pattern-prescription returns prescriptions array with pattern_type, label, recent_count, severity
GET /api/training/community-feed returns positions with pattern_type field (positional, fork, hanging_piece)
seed_data_creation: None - used existing user data (Mohit Maheshwari with 20 games, habits: Complex Tactical Miss, One Move Blunder, Positional Mistake)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 features verified working: 1) Pattern Clustering in Training - filter tabs (All, Positional, Fork, Hanging Piece) with counts, position counter updates on filter change. 2) Enhanced stats - solve-attempt returns miss_rate_at_your_level (null when insufficient data, percentage when available). 3) Habit Insight card - shows between Pattern Prescription and Last Game with purple Brain icon, displays improving habits in green or active habits in amber.
